O quadro \"Endereços liberados\" explica: The "Allowed addresses" panel explains the scope of the list. An address on it is no longer rejected just for being on the internal network, and all other rules still apply. On the actual server, the address must still start with https and have a valid certificate: a service that only responds over http is still rejected, even if listed. The list also only applies to services specified in the configuration file by whoever installed the server, such as the company search service on the "Prospecting" screen or the audio transcription service. These services are installed separately, and the list alone does not enable any of them. An address a company chooses in its own panel, such as an AI provider address, still cannot point to an internal destination, whether listed here or not.
Com o link aberto, aparecem logo abaixo: With the link expanded, two options appear below, each with its own copy button. Use the link wherever you control the address, such as a bio, an ad or a button. The script is a small piece of code that your website manager pastes once across all pages; with it, the regular WhatsApp buttons for that number stay as they are and the code is added automatically. Use only one script per number. In "Website URL", enter your page address starting with https:// and click "Check installation": the system opens the website in a tab (allow it to open) and reports within 20 seconds whether it found the script. If it does not confirm, check with your website manager before assuming it is missing.
O quadro \"Serviço externo de envio\" te: The "External sending service" panel has two fields, and both must be filled in for it to work. The system currently works with Resend (resend.com): the key accepted here comes from that service. "Email service key" is the code Resend gives you; it stays hidden and, once saved, only its last four characters appear. "Sender address" is the email address your customers see and must belong to a domain you verified in Resend. The "Not configured" badge beside each field means nothing has been set yet. The gray sentence below the key only applies if you have not saved your own server in the panel above.
Depois de cada horário, o sistema pede à: After each appointment, the system asks the team to confirm whether the customer attended. Without this confirmation, it never assumes a no-show. "Request confirmation after the end" sets how many minutes after the end this request appears. "Protect against follow-ups for silence" sets how long automatic messages asking the customer to respond are held while no one confirms. "Release the slot for an unconfirmed request", which only applies to types requiring confirmation, sets how long an appointment request that no one has approved holds the slot; the customer is not notified when it is released. Adjust these settings and click "Save deadlines".
O primeiro cartão, sem título, logo abai: The first, untitled card just below the notices is for the Facebook and Instagram (Meta) ad account. Enter the number of the data source that receives sales in "Conversion destination ID". You can find it in Meta Events Manager under Data sources. In "Access token", enter the key generated in that data source's settings. Here it has already been saved: the field is empty and says "Saved. Leave blank to keep.", because the key is never displayed again. The "Report sales automatically" switch enables or pauses sending. After making changes, click "Save connection".
Quando um número cai, o selo do cartão m: When a number disconnects, its card's badge changes. The red "Disconnected" and "Stopped" badges mean the number is not working. The yellow "Scan the QR" badge asks you to scan the code again, and "Connecting…" appears while it reconnects. A red banner also appears at the top of every system screen, warning that no messages are coming in or going out through it. The "Reconnect" button, available on every card, tries to reconnect the number without your phone. If that fails, the window that opens shows a QR code to scan or, if the number was unlinked from the phone, the "Generate new QR" button.
O cartão Contenção conta as mensagens qu: The Containment card counts messages sent without a person writing them. "Messages sent by the agent" are those from the AI agent. On the right, under "What this cost", "Vetoes per run" shows the average number of times the system held an agent message before it was sent. Below are messages sent by automation (rules, follow-ups and appointment reminders) and by integrations with other systems, counted separately so they are not mixed with the agent's messages. When a number appears as "—", there was not enough data to measure it: the dash does not mean zero.
O último quadro avisa onde a sua marca a: The last panel shows where your brand still does not appear: the browser tab title and sign-in screen still use the system name. Team invitation and data request emails already use your company name when email sending is enabled in the system. The LGPD report delivered to the customer uses the legal business name from Settings › Organization. The name, color and email display name are only saved when you click "Save" at the bottom of the page. The logo works differently: it is saved as soon as you choose the file.
Este pedido de apagamento foi atendido h: This deletion request was fulfilled 3 days ago. The badge says "Completed", the "Details" panel shows when it finished under "Completed at", and the "Audit trail" records the three steps: receipt from the store ("lgpd.redact_received"), approval ("lgpd.manually_approved", with the beginning of the approver's code after "by") and completed deletion ("lgpd.redact_completed"). The "SLA timeline" keeps counting days even after completion: the "Completed" badge and "Completed at" date are what confirm the request was fulfilled.
A etapa \"Consulta agendada\" foi ligada: The "Appointment scheduled" stage was linked to the "Lead submitted" event. The suggestion comes from the stage name: names containing scheduling, appointment, visit or meeting become "Lead submitted"; those containing quote, proposal or estimate become "Checkout started (quote)"; those containing qualification or interest become "Qualified lead". You can change the event in "Event sent to Meta" (the name in parentheses is what Meta uses; you can ignore it). Stages without a suggestion stay as they were. The won stage does not appear here because sales are already sent through the connection.
De volta à aba \"Membros\", abaixo da eq: Back on the "Members" tab, the "Invitations" list is below the team. It shows the role, "Status" ("Pending", "Expired", "Accepted" or "Revoked"), whether the email was sent, when it was sent, its expiration date and who invited the person. "Not sent" means the email was not delivered: use "Copy link" and send the link to the person through WhatsApp. If the invitation is "Expired", first use "Resend" to renew the deadline, then copy the link. If it was resent, the date shows how many times, such as "(resent 1x)".
Abre a janela \"Configure a verificação: The "Set up two-step verification" window opens. Clicking "Start setup" displays a QR code: add a new account in your authenticator app and point the camera at it. If you cannot use the camera, click "Can't scan? Enter the code manually" and copy the sequence into the app. The app starts showing a 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds. Enter it in the window: it checks automatically when you enter the sixth digit (the "Confirm" button does the same).
\"Ritmo entre envios\" é o tempo mínimo: "Sending interval" is the minimum time between messages from the same number, plus a variation that changes with each message, because a constant pace looks robotic. "Human delay" is how long the AI waits before the first reply, like someone who saw the notification and typed a response. It is measured in milliseconds: 3000 means 3 seconds. The "Daily sending cap" is the maximum number of messages the number sends per day. It defaults to 300. For a new number, whichever is lower applies: the cap or the warm-up limit.
Pela LGPD, o cliente de uma empresa pode: Under the LGPD, a company's customer can request a copy of the data it holds about them or ask for that data to be deleted (the system anonymizes it: the name becomes "Anonymized Customer"). Currently, these requests only arrive through a Nuvemshop store connected to the company; if no company has a connected Nuvemshop store, the list is empty. This screen combines requests from ALL companies on your server (that is what "Cross-tenant" means). Below the title is the number of requests shown in the list.
Confira os dados e clique em \"Criar org: Check the details and click "Create organization". The company is created and appears in the list as "Onboarding" until the initial setup is complete. You enter it as an administrator to perform that setup. The person in charge receives an invitation to become the owner: the screen shows the invitation link and "Copy invitation" button, and if email is configured on the server, the invitation is also emailed. The invitation expires. Your access to the company is temporary and ends when the owner accepts.
\"Membros e e-mails de acesso\" lista as: "Members and sign-in emails" lists the people linked to this company, with their sign-in email and role. Badges show who is the "Owner", who is a "Platform admin" and who has had "Access revoked". This is where you fix the email of someone who registered incorrectly: "Change email" changes the sign-in and password recovery address, and the company receives a notice. The button is disabled for platform admins, who can only change their email through their own account, and for people whose access has already been revoked.
A configuração abre no alto da página, c: The settings open at the top of the page with four tabs: "Service" (how bookings work), "Hours" (when they happen), "Google" (publish to a Google calendar, if Google Calendar is connected) and "Blocks" (prevent bookings during a period). Changes apply to new bookings; existing ones stay as they are. "Require human confirmation" holds the slot until someone on the team confirms. At the top, "Name and duration" returns to the type's details and "Close" collapses these settings.
O botão \"Enviar\" só funciona com uma o: The "Send" button only works when an option is selected and the field is filled in. Sending displays the notice "Response recorded for processing.". With "Done", the case moves to the "Completed" tab and the AI writes to the customer (AI and WhatsApp must be enabled for this). With "I can't — hand over to a human", it also moves to "Completed" and the conversation passes to the team. With "I need information from the customer", it stays in "Open", now marked "Waiting for the customer".
Logo abaixo aparece a escala que o siste: Below is the scale the system builds from your color. The outlined shades are the ones actually used on screen, and the legend identifies them: "Your color", "Buttons in light mode" and "Buttons in dark mode". Here, in light mode, the button uses your exact color. In dark mode, it uses a lighter shade from the same scale so it stands out against the dark background. With some colors, light mode also uses a neighboring shade to keep the text on the button readable.
Enquanto o aplicativo do Google não está: While the Google application has not been registered, the Calendar screen shows the panel "Google sync is not available yet". The Calendar works normally; it just does not exchange appointments with Google. The installation administrator sees the "Register Google credentials" link there, which leads directly to the Admin screen. Other team members only see the notice, without the link. The panel also reminds you to register the callback address in Google, the same one from step 2.
\"Usuário\" e \"Senha\" são os da conta: "Username" and "Password" belong to the email account that will send messages: usually the email address itself and its password. Note: some providers (such as Gmail and Outlook) do not accept your regular password here and require an "app password", which you generate in your email account's security settings. The password is stored encrypted and never appears on this screen again. Once saved, the field stays empty: leave it that way to keep the password, or enter another one to change it.
A tela Desempenho junta os números do at: The Performance screen brings together the clinic's customer support and sales figures. Open it from the menu under "Performance", in the Analytics group. Most figures cover the last 30 days up to now, and you cannot choose another period on this screen. The Pipeline and Forecast are the exceptions: they show deals that are open now. The "Agent" field filters some sections to a single team member; it is covered in a later lesson.
Embaixo, três linhas comparam o que a em: Below, three rows compare the company's usage with the plan limits. "People" counts those with system access. "Connected numbers" counts channels registered in Connections that have not been deleted, even if currently disconnected. "AI usage this month" shows how much all artificial intelligence features in the system have spent this month, in dollars, and resets to zero at the start of each month. When a plan has no limit, it says "unlimited".
As mensagens aparecem na ordem em que fo: Messages appear in the order they were exchanged, as in the company's Inbox. Customer messages are on the left; company messages are on the right, with a badge showing who sent them: "AI" for artificial intelligence, "Agent" for someone on the team using the system, and "Phone" for replies from WhatsApp on a phone. Only the 50 most recent messages appear here; to see earlier ones, enter the company using "View organization".
A peça \"Espera a resposta\" segura o fl: The "Wait for response" block holds the flow until the patient replies or the timeout expires. "Wait for response for (minutes)" sets the timeout: here, 2880 minutes, or two days. If time runs out without a reply, the flow follows the "No response" path to the next message. "Text rules" contains a word (here, "I want") that leads to its own path, but it is only used when "Cancel if the lead replies", in the flow trigger, is turned off.
No quadro \"Segurança e privacidade\", \: In the "Security and privacy" panel, "Data protection officer (DPO) email" is the contact required by the LGPD for privacy requests. It appears in privacy documents and when delivering data requested by a patient, and receives a notice when a request becomes overdue. If the company filled in its own officer under Settings, that contact is used. This is the contact used when it has not. Enter the email and click "Save" beside it.
Clique no círculo do canto de cima, à di: Click the circle in the upper-right corner to open your account menu. At the top are your name and email, as saved in Profile. The circle shows your photo or, without a photo, your initials (here, "HP", for Helena Prado). Below, server administrators see "Administrator mode". "Sign out" disconnects you from every device where you were signed in, not just this one, and phone notifications also stop.
As etiquetas coloridas, como \"convenio\: Colored tags, such as "insurance", have already been registered with a color. The "in use, outside the vocabulary" badge, as on "Physio", marks tags that are in use (on customers, deals, conversations or in a rule) but were never registered: someone or some rule simply wrote them. At the end of each row are the "Color", "Rename", "Merge" and "Delete" buttons. Each opens a panel just below the list, and the next lessons cover them one by one.
O primeiro bloco, \"Atrito\", mostra o q: The first section, "Friction", shows what the result cost the customer and the team. The sentence at the top explains the basis for the figures: how many requests were closed in the last 30 days and how many are still open. A request is a customer's need, from the beginning to the end of service. Below is the threshold that determines how many hours without a reply make a conversation count as lost; it has its own lesson.
Este quadro só aparece para quem adminis: This panel only appears for the CRM installation administrator. A catalog is a file listing extensions someone offers for installation. Click "Choose JSON file", select the file, then click "Admit catalog". The CRM records who admitted it, when, the source address and the file's version number, and its extensions become visible on the "Catalog" tab. Admission does not install anything: installation is the next step.
O Radar mostra os negócios ainda abertos: Radar shows deals still open in the pipeline where no one has made changes or spoken to the customer for more than 24 hours. Customer messages do not count: customers writing with no one replying is precisely the risk. The three tags at the top count deals at each level. The yellow panel above them is a different list, for customers waiting with no agreed next step; it has its own lesson, "Requests without a next step".
Clique numa linha para abrir os detalhes: Click a row to open its details. Here, the sale Meta rejected: the reason and Meta's response appear at the top. "Event ID" is the code used to find this sale in the platform's manager; delivered events also show a "Receipt". Below are the amount and when the sale occurred. "Open deal" takes you to the deal in the pipeline, and because this event was not delivered, "Check or try again" also appears.
Cada linha é uma pessoa dentro de uma em: Each row is a person within a company. "Email" and "Name" are from the account. "Tenant" is the company, with its short system identifier below. "Role" is the person's role in that company: Admin, Manager, Agent or Viewer (the last can only view, not change anything). "Last access" shows how long ago the account last signed in to the system, in any company; a dash means it has never signed in.
Cada linha mostra o assunto do caso, esc: Each row shows the case subject, written by the AI, and a status badge. "Waiting for you" means the AI is waiting for a team decision. "Waiting for the customer" means the team has already requested information and the customer now needs to respond. Below are the request type (such as "Payment" or "Appointment"), the customer's name and how long ago the case was opened. Newer cases appear at the top.
Mais abaixo, \"O texto em cima dos botõe: Further down, "Text on buttons" checks whether the writing on buttons is easy to read with your color, in light and dark modes. "passes AA" means it meets the recommended minimum. Under "What the system adjusted", it explains whether the shade needed darkening or lightening. The yellow line warns that, for people who have difficulty distinguishing colors, yours is similar to the system's error color.
Instalado, o módulo ganha uma tela dentr: Once installed, the module gets a screen within each company. "Service tabs" is in CRM: open "View all in CRM" and look under "Day-to-day sales". This card does not appear before installation. "Professional fees" appears under "View all in Analytics", in "Money". If a company selected its menu items individually, the new screen only appears after someone there enables it in Settings, under "Sidebar menu".
Em \"Como está agora\", o quadro \"De on: Under "Current state", the "Where each item comes from" panel shows who determined the active name, logo and color: this screen ("set on this screen"), the server installation file ("from the server installation file") or the system default ("system default"). On a new installation, the name usually comes from the installation file, while the logo and color use the system default.
Clique em \"Receber no celular: instalar: Click "Receive on your phone: install the app" to open the Mobile app screen. This is the shortest route when someone on the team says their phone is not notifying them. Check three things: whether the Notifications notice says alerts only appear with the website open (the server administrator must resolve that), whether the app is installed on that phone, and whether "New message" Push is enabled on it.
A aba 'Clientes' lista as empresas que t: The 'Customers' tab lists companies with a plan. For each, you see the plan, 'Status' ('Free trial', 'Current', 'Overdue' or 'Canceled') and 'Next due date' (during a free trial, the day it ends). 'Last check' is when the system last checked payment, and the 'Problem' column shows what went wrong during that check. Companies without a plan do not appear here: they are exempt.
O campo \"Mês\" já vem no mês atual: a m: The "Month" field defaults to the current month: the target applies from day 1 through its last day. In "Sales won this month", enter how many deals the clinic wants to close as won. Here, Helena entered 20. Use an integer greater than zero: when the field is empty or zero, "Save target" is disabled. Below the number, "There is no target for this month yet." confirms that no target has been saved for this month.
O botão \"Cancelar\" aparece, para geren: The "Cancel" button appears for managers and administrators on rows that have not finished, including paused ones. It always asks for confirmation. For a follow-up agreed by the AI, it asks "Cancel this follow-up?": the agent will not contact the person again at the agreed time. For a flow, it asks "Cancel this follow-up?" and cannot be undone. "Back" closes the question without canceling anything.
Deixe marcado 'Só o que eu marcar (recom: Keep 'Only what I select (recommended)' selected. When the CRM reaches the database, its tables appear here, each with a checkbox to allow access. After selecting a table, the 'Details' button lets you choose columns and write a description for the assistant. In this example, the database did not respond, so a notice says the catalog could not be read and a 'Try again' button appears.
Na aba \"Propostas\", o agente sugere me: On the "Suggestions" tab, the agent suggests improvements learned from real conversations. Nothing is applied automatically: each suggestion has a button you can use to apply it if you agree. Note: "Apply as new version" publishes the change immediately, without going through a draft, and keeps the previous version in History. Suggestions depend on the artificial intelligence access key; there are none yet.
Clique em \"Tipo: todos\" para abrir a l: Click "Type: all" to open the list of types. "Data request" means the customer is requesting a copy of their data. "Customer anonymization" means the customer is asking to be deleted. "Tenant anonymization" appears when someone uninstalls the CRM app from a Nuvemshop store. In that case, the system automatically deletes personal data for all the company's contacts in the CRM, not just store customers.
No fim da tela, \"Atividade recente\" gu: At the bottom, "Recent activity" keeps a receipt for each request: catalog admission, installation, update or version change, rollback, removal and configuration. Each shows the result ("Completed", "Failed" or "Canceled"), date and time. A request still underway appears as "Preparing": whoever made it can check or cancel it; other authorized people can only cancel it.
Neste exemplo, o servidor 192.168.0.50 n: In this example, server 192.168.0.50 did not respond. The badge changed to 'Last test failed' and the red line shows the reason in English. Send that line to whoever manages the other system: it is usually an address, port, password or network restriction issue. When the test succeeds, the badge becomes 'Connected'. If no table has been selected yet, the connection page opens automatically so you can do that.
A aba \"Atividade\" mostra cada vez que: The "Activity" tab shows each time an automation ran, newest first. Each card shows the rule name, how long ago it ran and the result. "Success" means all the rule's actions succeeded; for a notification, that the other system acknowledged receipt. "Failed" means no action succeeded; for a notification, that the other system did not accept it or did not respond.
\"Mensagens\" conta as enviadas e recebi: "Messages" counts those sent and received during the period, excluding contacts marked as personal. "Conversations" counts conversations started during the period. "AI calls" counts each time the system called the AI: agent responses, tests, audio processing, the knowledge base and other tasks. "Tokens" totals the text it read and wrote. "AI cost" is how much that cost, in dollars.
Clique em \"Personalizar áreas visíveis\: Click "Customize visible areas" to select and deselect each area, organized by group. The list scrolls: scrolling within it reveals other areas such as Contacts, Tasks and Connections. Changing a checkbox adds "(customized)" to the title. To apply it, click "Apply interface" (until then, the left menu stays the same): "Company sidebar menu saved." appears.
Ao clicar em \"Salvar programação\", apa: Clicking "Save schedule" displays confirmation of how many future bookings were kept. Pilates now has a class on Tuesdays at 19:00, with up to 6 places, and its row in the list shows "Group with capacity · 6". Below, under "Check saved times", select a date and click "Refresh sources and check" to view that day's times before sharing them.
Acima do campo de escrever há duas opçõe: Above the writing field are two options: "Reply" sends the message to the customer, and "Internal note" saves a message for the team only. With note selected, the "Internal note" button is colored, the area around the field turns yellowish and the field shows "Write an internal note… (only the team can see it)". Quick reply buttons disappear because they are for customers.
Abra uma conversa na Inbox: a resposta n: Open a conversation in the Inbox: the new reply is already among the buttons above the message field. Clicking it places the text in the field, with the customer's name already substituted. Note: it replaces anything you had already written. Nothing is sent until you review it and click send. If the buttons are disabled, the conversation cannot receive a reply yet (for example, you need to take it first).
Em \"Logo\", clique no botão de escolher: Under "Logo", click the file chooser and select your logo image: PNG or JPG, up to 512 KB, preferably with a transparent background. SVG is not accepted. The logo is saved immediately, without clicking "Save": "Logo updated." appears, along with a "Remove" button. If the file is large, the system tries to crop empty borders and reduce the image before uploading.
Quando o plano novo é mais caro, a tela: When the new plan costs more, the screen shows an estimate of the adjustment: the price difference only for the days remaining until the next renewal. The renewal date does not change. Confirming opens payment for that adjustment (for boleto/Pix, an "Open invoice" button appears). The new limits apply after payment is confirmed. Until then, the current limits remain.
Cole em \"Endereço (URL)\" o endereço qu: Paste the address the other system gave you for receiving notifications into "Address (URL)". The "Secret (optional)" lets the other system verify that the notification really came from your CRM. Only fill it in if its administrator asks; the gray text is just an example. "Include the assignee in the body" is off: only turn it on if the other system needs to know which team member serves the customer.
Só quem é administrador da plataforma en: Only platform administrators can enter Admin. This area does not open for support agents, managers or even a company administrator, unless that person is also a platform administrator. The yellow "SMTP not configured" banner at the top is a general Admin notice: email sending has not been configured yet. The "Email" menu item takes you to that setting.
Os dois últimos campos dizem quem aparec: The last two fields determine who appears as the sender. In "Sender email", preferably use the sending account's own address (or one that account has permission to use), otherwise your server may reject the message. "Sender name" is a fallback name: invitations and LGPD notices use the company's brand name.
\"O que ele consulta antes de responder\: "What it checks before replying" is your clinic's material the agent can read, such as frequently asked questions, prices and exam preparation instructions. It searches there before replying and cites its source. This clinic has no material yet, and the link takes you to the registration screen. With no material selected, it replies using only what the artificial intelligence already knows.
\"Actor IP\" e \"User Agent\" mostram o: "Actor IP" and "User Agent" show the address and browser of whoever acted, when the system recorded them; a dash means they were not recorded. "Request ID" is the request number, useful for support to find the case in technical logs. "Bypassed RLS" = "Yes" means the action bypassed separation between companies, as server administrator actions do.
\"Voltar ao padrão\" apaga o que foi gra: "Restore default" deletes what was saved on this screen, and the system goes back to the value in the server installation file. "Restored the value from the installation file." appears. Since that file has no value in this demonstration, the "Now:" line disappears and the badge returns to "Not configured". "Restore default" disappears until you save again.
Cada parte tem as setas ↑ e ↓, que sobem: Each section has ↑ and ↓ arrows to move it up and down in the proposal, and "Remove" to take it out of the template. Below the text, "Only show if data exists" hides the section from the proposal when none of its fields are filled in, as with "What is not included". "Required" deselects this option: the section always appears. Both cannot be selected together.
O botão abre \"Configurações › Propostas: The button opens "Settings › Proposals". Server approval is not enough: the company must also enable proposals for itself using this first switch (the top one, still off) and click "Save". The green switch further down does something else: it only notifies the team on WhatsApp when the AI drafts a proposal. The "Proposals" module in this course teaches the rest.
De volta aos Recursos opcionais, a linha: Back in Optional features, the "Company business proposal" row under "Your company" shows the company's switch: it stays "Off" until someone enables it and saves. Proposals only work with both switches on, for the server and the company. If the server disables the module, this row says "Disabled by the server administrator".
O gerente nem vê o cartão \"Meta Ads\" e: The manager cannot even see the "Meta Ads" card in Settings. Opening the connection page directly by its address shows "403 — Permission denied". Only an administrator can enable or change the token: it gives access to the company's entire ad account, and choosing which account to connect is an administrative decision. "Back to Inbox" takes you back to work.
Cada linha é uma empresa. \"Slug\" é o a: Each row is a company. "Slug" is its short system identifier, without spaces or accents. "Name" is how the team sees it. "CNPJ" shows only the start of the number. "Users" counts access links to the company, including people who have lost access. "Conversations" counts its conversations. "Created at" is the day the company was created on the server.
Cada linha é uma conversa. Em cima vem o: Each row is a conversation. At the top are the customer's name and when the last message arrived: the time if today; how many days ago if this week; or the date if earlier. Below, a badge with a building identifies the company. The last line shows the start of the last message and, when applicable, a number for unread messages.
The "Plans" tab lists what you sell. Each plan shows its price, free-trial days and limits: people, connected numbers and monthly AI spending. The "Sign-up plan" badge marks the plan people who register themselves receive, with a free trial. "Only you can assign" marks a negotiated plan: companies cannot see it; only you assign it to them.
A tela Atividades mostra o que aconteceu: The Activities screen shows what happened in your CRM during a period and who did each thing. Each event was recorded on a pipeline deal: a stage change, taking a conversation, booking an appointment or completing a task. The screen opens on the "Activities" tab with "Last 7 days" selected. The total number of events in the period appears on the right.
Para desfazer tudo, clique em \"Voltar a: To undo everything, click "Restore organization default". The number loses its own rule and assignee list and goes back to using all the organization's agents and distribution settings. The sentence at the top returns to "Uses all eligible agents in the organization.". "Assignees saved." appears below again to confirm the change.
A frase do alto garante que a ligação é: The sentence at the top guarantees the connection is read-only: nothing is created, paused or changed in your ad account. The blue panel says what you need to provide: an access token, a special password Facebook generates so the system can read your ads.
